data.title: Complete After-Wudu Dua
data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
data.translation: O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves.

api_info.sadaqah_jariah: This API is provided as sadaqah jariah for the Muslim ummah
